title: In her arms he felt that he had suddenly become strong and fearless and sure of himself. But his lips would not bend to kiss her.
html_source:
Signifies Stephen’s first successful encounter with a women! But where does his source of satisfaction come from? It comes from the relief he feels to find security in a physical embrace. He finally felt comfortable in his emotional vulnerability. Yes, a man needed a shoulder to cry on. Yes, a man ACTUALLY went to a prostitute not for sex, but for emotional support during a vulnerable state.

To prove my argument as I was googling “a man crying in a woman’s arms” the only photos that appeared in the search were these…

If only someone was there to capture this exact moment between Stephen and his lady of the night for google’s sake. Well, at least Joyce shows that it is possible for a man to need or rely on a woman for emotional strength and support!
